why: 1.0.1-beta: same build as 1.0.0-beta.2, for everyone on CurseForge

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.1-beta - Persian for WoW Forever (game build 1.60.1.71037).

Translates quests (window, quest list beside the map, tracker), NPC names (nameplates, target, tooltips), zone names (map, minimap, arrival), spells and talents (names and descriptions), red alerts, system chat lines, chat bubbles and flight masters. Persian font, right-to-left text, Persian digits.

Settings: /wowfa or the minimap icon. Every part can be switched on and off; presets, profiles (save your settings and put them back with one click), share codes, colours, and one Font sizes page.

This is a beta: report anything that looks wrong. A wrong NPC name: target it and type /wowfa target.

Data from ForeverDB.net
